name: aladdin.spacing
description: Canonical 4-based spacing scale. Use tokens, never arbitrary pixel values.
maintenance: Manually maintained. Edit here first, then DESIGN.md frontmatter and frontend/tailwind.config.ts (theme.extend.spacing).

lg.usage: Mobile body gutter; separation between groups.

rules.grouping: Spacing, not dividers, is the first grouping tool: tight within a group, generous between groups.
rules.heading: More space sits above a heading than below it.
rules.canonical-rhythm: Mobile body gutter 24; flow-header padding [16,20]; inter-field gap 16; field height ~64.
